score_configuration.architecture: final MVTec architecture reported in manuscript

oracle_min_review_fraction.at_90_percent_recall: k_90 / n_total, where k_90 = ceil(0.90 * n_anomalies)
oracle_min_review_fraction.at_95_percent_recall: k_95 / n_total, where k_95 = ceil(0.95 * n_anomalies)

normalized_review_efficiency.interpretation: 1.0 indicates the oracle minimum review fraction, 0.0 corresponds to the exact finite-sample random-ranking expectation, and negative values indicate worse-than-random high-recall efficiency.
